recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中充滿小到中型、核質比高的母細胞，細胞質少呈淡藍色、無顆粒，部分細胞質拉出一端尾巴呈手鏡形（hand-mirror）；形態上只能判定為淋巴母細胞樣，ETP-ALL 的診斷需要流式細胞儀。
features: Monotonous small-to-medium blasts, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of red cells, with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed to moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale-to-moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm, focally polarized into a tail (hand-mirror forms)
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules in the blasts
Occasional mature small lymphocyte for size comparison; residual normal hematopoiesis is sparse
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a sheet-like infiltrate of small-to-medium sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is scant, lightly basophilic and agranular, and several blasts display a polarized cytoplasmic tail imparting hand-mirror morphology. Auer rods are not identified. Findings are consistent with a lymphoblastic leukemia; the early T-cell precursor subtype cannot be distinguished morphologically and requires flow cytometric immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts look identical including hand-mirror forms and are separated only by CD19/CD79a expression without cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts may be agranular and similar in size but are cCD3 negative on flow, while ETP-ALL shares CD34/CD117/CD13 and needs cCD3 to separate.
Blastoid MCL cells are TdT negative, CD5 and cyclin D1 positive with a mature B-cell phenotype.
Hematogones have smoother condensed chromatin, are present in lower numbers and show an orderly maturation continuum on flow.
